<issue>
Timed Text IMSC 1.1 subs - Spaces inside italic spans
There seems to be an issue on dealing with spaces inside italic spans in subs using the format Timed Text IMSC 1.1.

I send you 2 files in attachment where the behaviour is different, one is correct and the other one is not.

In the file "italics_space_before.xml", there is a space inside the italic span before the word on lines 26 and 451 and it keeps the space correctly when converting to srt.

In the file "italics_space_after.xml", there is a space inside the italic span after the word on lines 31, 50 and 170 and it does not keep the space so the words are incorrectly joined.

[italics_space_after.xml](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26225587/italics_space_after.xml)
[italics_space_before.xml](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26225586/italics_space_before.xml)

</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

content.text: I fixed the IMSC 1.1 parser so it no longer drops a trailing space inside a span. I haven't built it or run any tests, and I haven't tried your two sample files. **Cause:** in `src/libse/SubtitleFormats/TimedTextImsc11.cs`, `ReadParagraph` ended with `TrimEnd()`. It calls itself for each span, so the space at the end of an italic span was cut off before `` was added. `word next` therefore became `wordnext`. A leading space survived because only the end was trimmed. **Fix:** `ReadParagraph` is now a thin wrapper that calls a new `ReadParagraphInner` and trims the end once on the whole paragraph. Spans recurse into `ReadParagraphInner`, which doesn't trim. I did not touch `NetflixImsc11Japanese.cs` or `TimedTextImscRosetta.cs`. Both have the same `TrimEnd()`-in-a-recursive-`ReadParagraph` pattern, but the issue only concerns IMSC 1.1. The helper only read them and didn't confirm the bug there.
